Great! Planify remembered your plans for today.
Now you're gonna get notified about them every 2 hours.

You can add anything to your plans easily -
just write it above.

Welcome! Here you can write all your plans for today - from the most significant to minor ones. After that, Planify will remind you about them every 2 hours. And, of course, you can change plans later!
Yesterday is over, and there\'s a new amazing day ahead. Time to think about your plans for today - or give yourself a break.
Hey! You have great things planned
Hey! Refresh your plans in memory
Plans\'ve been reset. What\'s on agenda today?
Plans\'ve been forgotten. What\'re you gonna do today?
Plans\'ve been disappeared. What about today\'s ones?
Снова впереди целый день, открытый для твоих свершений. Удачи тебе сегодня!
Впереди - новый день, а вчерашний подошёл к концу. Пора поразмыслить над списком дел на сегодня!
Может, снаружи это не так, но в Planify уже царит рождественская атмосфера.\nНе забывай о себе - тем более в такое время года ❄️
cold outside\nbut stay warm inside of you ❤️
Let is snow, let it snow, let it snow...
In the new year, all your plans will definitely come true, and your efforts will pay off.
